avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Magnesium supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May reduce gabapentin enacarbil absorption via competitive LAT1 transporter inhibition; additive CNS depression risk
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by 2+ hours; monitor for reduced efficacy and increased sedation

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; increased dizziness, drowsiness, and ataxia
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on CNS depression risks

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased drowsiness, dizziness, or impaired cognition; counsel on safety with machinery

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.action: Advise patient to monitor for enhanced sedation or dizziness

caution_supplements.name: Melatonin
caution_supplements.action: Use lowest effective dose; monitor for excessive daytime somnolence

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May delay gabapentin enacarbil absorption; peak plasma levels reduced
caution_foods.action: Take with consistent meal timing; consider taking with light meals for optimal absorption

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased risk of dizziness, drowsiness, impaired coordination, and cognitive effects
caution_foods.action: Counsel patient to minimize or avoid alcohol consumption; warn against driving or hazardous activities if combined

monitoring_notes: Gabapentin enacarbil is primarily renally eliminated with minimal hepatic metabolism, reducing drug-drug interaction potential. Monitor renal function and for signs of CNS depression, particularly when combined with other depressants; dose adjustment may be necessary in renal impairment.
